proof_requests: Clear photo of the fuel tank or side panel showing brand/model name.
Video of the engine starting and idling.
Full side view from the opposite side and a front view.

response.reason: The single rear photo does not reveal the brand or model, which is the key factor setting a motorcycle's price bracket, so even a worst-case price cannot be assigned without an identifying shot.
